items.title: Spiegle Willcox and Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Norwich, New York, November 14, 1995
items.q: on the “50th Anniversary” album that I did the “Rhapsody in Blue,” and unabridged we do the whole thing with Buddy Reid.

ctx.x: He told them it was a gig or something?

Yeah. He was a great violinist. Incidentally on the “50th Anniversary” album that I did the “Rhapsody in Blue,” and unabridged we do the whole thing with Buddy Reid. Tommy Dorsey is on this, Jimmy Dorsey is on it, a lot of guys.
